The Fellowship T.A. 3001–3021
travelled between consecutive dated events (≤ 30 days apart)
longer gap or year-only date: the timeline gives no route; the line is a straight join
Lines are straight between known places, except a few river/road legs. Places not printed on the map are estimated from Tolkien's descriptions, using distances measured with the map's scale bar where the text gives them.
Keys: ← → previous/next event, space play/pause.
